text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after her debut race, a package addressed to me arrived from Eishin Flash's parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's decorated with tree nuts, dried flowers,
and looking closely, even spices.
It's remarkably symmetrical and meticulously crafted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the enclosed message card,
"Congratulations on making your Debut,"
was written in neat, well-balanced Japanese.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I received the same wreath as well.
Though the message is different.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"May the joy of making your debut last forever throughout the rest of your athletic career."
...It seems that was the sentiment put into it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The moment I opened the box, a faint aroma of spices drifted out...
I knew right away it was made by my mother.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Wreath-making has been my mother's hobby
for quite some time.
choice_data_list: You made something that incredible just as a hobby...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Both my mother and father are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are very good with their hands,
so they pick up anything right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Mother has great taste, as you can see from the wreath,
and Father is knowledgeable about many things besides confectioneries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Most of the furniture back home was designed by my mother and built by my father!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents often humbly say, 'It's just an amateur's work,'
but... it really is wonderful.
I'd love for you to see it too, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: You really respect your parents, huh.
You really respect your parents, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have deep... respect for them.
To me, those two are—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because it's a "symbol" of righteousness, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For my mother, racing; for my father, cakes. Both have stayed true to their respective paths.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘May you see the path you chose
through to the very end’...
That's what was written in the message to me."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to my parents' expectations and walk the same path as them.
...But the way I am now isn't enough."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am still far too inexperienced, not even coming close to matching the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, my mother taught me
how to make wreaths too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: “However, it fell far short of what Mother makes…… so I asked her how to make it properly.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“It is all about accumulation, Flash.”
—That was what my mother taught me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Just as branches are woven together properly,
if you accumulate effort the right way...
it will surely take on a beautiful form."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Much like weaving a wreath,
my mother prepared meticulously, visualizing the final picture,
before taking on a race... and ran it through just as envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't put in enough proper effort or built up enough experience.
The schedule is the guideline to achieve that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will stick to my schedule
and become the person I ought to be...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And then, I shall return to Germany, proud and dignified...
and let the two of them see me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her obsession with "righteousness"
seems to stem from her deep admiration for her parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make my parents proud."
As she calmly described her grand plan, touching on that simple wish made me realize before I knew it—
choice_data_list: We have to make sure they see it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, Trainer, where is the wreath right now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I hung it next to the door. That spot
gets no sunlight throughout the entire year, so
the wreath shouldn't fade at all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. ...After this,
do you mind if we discuss
our training schedule?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Especially leading up to the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), I'd like to adjust the workload to be heavier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Receiving my parents' feelings has made my
desire to grow even stronger once again."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I told you before that winning wasn't
strictly my goal. But...
I want my mother to see me win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when we talked about the three-year schedule before,
she spoke with extraordinary passion about the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Is it something special?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, my mother once took me
to see the Deutsches Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That race was wonderful as well, but...
Mother said this to me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Foreign Derbys... like the Japanese Derby, for example, are also very thrilling and supposedly amazing every year."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I asked:
'If I run in that race, will I be amazing too?'"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Mother answered with the brightest smile of the day:
'Super, toll, klasse, Flash!'

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They all mean 'amazing,'
but it's the first time I've ever heard Mother string them together so excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...If I win at the Derby,
Mother will surely be pleased.
If that is so, then win I must."
choice_data_list: So making your mother happy is your dream, huh?
So making your mother happy is your dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...The word 'dream'
is hardly appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The illusions one sees while asleep are also called dreams.
'Dream' is a vague word, an elusive term."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To me, bringing joy to my mother...
is not a dream. It is a reality, something I must achieve.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, to win the Derby,
let us analyze and verify our training.
choice_data_list: I'll keep you company for as long as you want.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Now, regarding the start time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It became a day where I learned the weight of her parents' presence in Eishin Flash's life, and the true meaning of doing things right—
